description: Transform lessons, materials, and assessments into classroom-ready game-based learning experiences where the learning itself drives meaningful gameplay.

defaultPrompt: Help me turn a lesson into a game-based learning experience.
interface.longDescription: Redesign existing lessons, worksheets, assessments, readings, reviews, presentations, and tasks as classroom-ready game-based learning experiences. Preserve the intended learning while using purposeful mechanics such as meaningful choice, progression, feedback, retry, resource management, mystery, collaboration, and strategic challenge to make academic thinking necessary for successful gameplay.

name: game-theory-learning-designer-lqt
